text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Yizhe Chi Deborah Moriah
